beats.script: Your stomach is basically a muscle. It contracts, churns your food, and pushes everything forward. But GLP-1 medications slow those contractions down.

beats.note: river: 02:06.033–02:10.033. Straight cuts; aligned to new Michelle V3 narration. Original caption wording/style retained.

beats.script: Food backs up. Waste backs up. Gas builds with nowhere to go. And all that pressure is what you're feeling every single day.
beats.visual: Flat gut-lumen schematic: contents and several gas pockets within a soft tube; no full torso or repeated stomach.

beats.script: It wasn't a diet problem. It wasn't something I was doing wrong. It was the gut slowdown.

beats.emotion: Relief — remove self-blame and close the first loop.
